latest_release.name: EGM v0.1.1
latest_release.body:
EGM v0.1.1 updates the plugin listing and packages the current Claude and OpenAI runtimes.

- Clarifies listing copy, adds three OpenAI plugin starter prompts, and separates publisher policy destinations (#316, #314).
- Adds the TRIZ inventive catalyst reviewer and improves review context handling and severity preservation (#299, #289, #279).
- Adds experimental Cursor, OpenCode V1, and GitHub Copilot adapters (#164, #165, #163).

Existing skill names, descriptions, and per-skill prompt files are unchanged by the listing update. No migration is required for that update. The experimental adapters have separate installation and support guidance.

The ZIP checksums and GitHub Actions attestations were verified against the workflow-built artifacts from commit `dea7761de06ce5b51c177ebb9bba0469f24af5a4`. Native end-to-end verification of these exact release ZIPs remains open in #60. Marketplace rollout is tracked separately.

detail.readme_excerpt:
Design with an elephant. Review with a goldfish.

Install  ·  Quickstart  ·  Documentation  ·  Website


Develop ideas with context and review documents with fresh eyes. EGM is an open-source plugin for AI assistants. **Elephant** holds your project context and drafts the specification. **Goldfish** reviewers examine the draft and referenced source material without the earlier conversation, helping expose unstated assumptions and blind spots. **You** make the architectural trade-offs and approve the specification before implementing. The built-in draft and design-review workflow targets software specifications. For other documents, choose reviewers and standards with `/egm-review-loop`. Bootstrap and drift reporting apply to software codebases. ## Install Choose your coding agent. Install the complete plugin so its skills can read the reviewer prompts and document standards. ### ChatGPT and Codex desktop Open the [published EGM plugin](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugins_6aeb90f47ec88191a3c107e01d3eb357) in the desktop app and install it. This listing is desktop-only. For Codex CLI, use the commands below. ### Antigravity CLI ```sh agy plugin install https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model ``` For the **Antigravity App** and **Antigravity for IDEs** (Visual Studio Code extension), run `/plugin` or see the [installation instructions](docs/harnesses.md#antigravity-app-and-antigravity-for-ides). ### Claude Code ```sh claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model claude plugin install egm@egm ``` ### Codex CLI ```sh codex plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model codex plugin add egm@egm ``` Start a new session after installation. For **Claude Cowork** and **ChatGPT Work**, see the [setup guide](docs/harnesses.md). ## Try your first design Open your project in your coding agent and choose a feature that needs design decisions. This example adds webhook delivery: what should happen when a delivery fails, or the same event arrives twice? The commands below are shown without a prefix. In Antigravity (agy CLI) and Claude Code, add the `/egm:` prefix, for example `/egm:egm-brainstorm`. On agy CLI 1.4.10 an unprefixed name is completed to the prefixed command ([#220](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/issues/220)), but 1.4.8 does not ([#196](https://github.com/google/elephant-goldfish-model/issues/196)), so keep the prefix. In Codex, select the corresponding EGM skill from the skill picker. Brainstorming and review require a session that can create fresh subagents.
